title: My First Snow Experience
body:
This is the beginning of my diary. There have been many “dear diary” moments in my life. I am an international student in the U.S., and I came from Bangladesh. It was always a dream of mine to see snowfall.

Today was the D-day. I woke up to bid farewell to my husband. He is also an international student and studies in a different state, New York. We knew the night before that there would be a snowstorm the next day. I had worked late on my updates, so I couldn’t wake up early.

When I finally opened the window, there it was - two inches of snow and a full snowstorm.

His eyes were dreamy as he looked into the snow. I was mesmerized. But seeing his amused eyes made it even more exciting and enjoyable. Then the bus arrived - the one he had to take. We quickly put on our jackets and grabbed an umbrella. Together, we left our first footprints in the snow. Sabit told me, “*This is exactly like the commandos.*”

![Our commando-style footprints, mine and Sabit’s, on the first snow of our lives.](i-1f60bf4ce2925d59.jpg)

Classes were cancelled. Meetings too. One nice day!

Life can be unpredictable. One minute you are happy; the next moment, you miss your previous life and its sorrows. But today, I was genuinely happy. It was one of my bucket list items.

I called my mother after I bade farewell to my husband and showed her the snowy view. She said, “তোমার নিশ্চয়ই খুব ভালো লাগছে। একেবারে গল্পের বইয়ের মতো।” And truly, it was just like that. We talked for five minutes, as I had a meeting to attend. I sent the images to my sister. However, the meeting was later canceled because of the same snowstorm.

Today, I had a delivery of a bed desktop. I also bought a floor rug so that it can be used for eating and studying. I saw people using sledges to carry their deliveries. Shoes were becoming icy, and the roads were slippery.

At night, the snow had accumulated, and there was the moon - full moon. Can you imagine the view? I watched the moon while lying on my floor rug. The best view.

![The yellow lights shimmered like tiny star emojis in the night. ✨](i-555dd58d310decc9.jpg)

I can’t thank Allah enough for creating this view and for everything in my life. I am truly indebted to Allah.
